annotations.title: Recent FDIC bank failures and real estate sales

description: The FDIC's most recent bank failures (bank, city, state, closing date, acquirer) and its recent closed sales of commercial real estate from the last three years (property, type, state, sale date, sold price), read daily from the FDIC. Useful for spotting where distressed bank assets may come to market.

state.description: Two-letter state code to filter, e.g. CA.
